gemini-omni-1.1-flash.description: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash conversational video generation, editing, and extension
gemini-omni-1.1-flash.pricingNotes: Gemini pricing bills Omni video output at $17.50 per 1M tokens, counted at 5,792 tokens per second of 720p video, about $0.10/s. 360p, 1080p, and 4K use the same published 720p effective rate until Google publishes resolution-specific token rates. 1080p and 4K are documented as upscaled. Input tokens ($1.50 per 1M) and thinking/text output ($9 per 1M) are extra and not modeled. Unspecified duration is budgeted at 10 seconds. Discounts, regional differences, taxes, and provider credits are ignored unless provider usage is returned.

grok-imagine-video-1.5.description: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 text, image, and reference video generation model
grok-imagine-video-1.5.pricingTier: xAI public Imagine API video pricing
grok-imagine-video-1.5.pricingNotes: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 output costs $0.08/s at 480p, $0.14/s at 720p, and $0.25/s at 1080p. Each input image costs $0.01. Reference-to-video is capped at 720p. Discounts, regional differences, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored unless provider usage is returned.

minimax/h3.description: MiniMax H3 multimodal video generation with native audio
minimax/h3.pricingNotes: fal.ai lists MiniMax H3 at $0.26 per generated second.

bytedance/seedance-2.5/text-to-video.pricingNotes: Published approximate output-second equivalents at 16:9. Token rate is $0.0214/1000 at 480p/720p, $0.0234/1000 at 1080p; reference videos apply 0.6 to the token rate and bill input plus output duration. Unknown input duration is budgeted at the 30.2s host limit. Audio on/off has the same price.
